sourceFindings.detail: Caller role and input-file filtering, independent destination, absent visible destination ACL and empty-string versus None distinction are supported.

Content and copying test truthiness. Empty content skips the content/delete branch; empty destination skips copying and sets add=False. With overwrite default False, an existing collection and add=False return True without inserting, while the route can still mark completion. The answer states None/empty but does not trace these actual branches.

The content update precedes embedding/vector work; the session is committed before the vector helper. Later failure marks failed and clears hash while changed content may remain. Default collection deletion precedes these stages and is independent of a supplied destination.
